user: Resistance ko paani ke flow ki simple analogy se samjhao. Iske liye cloud kaam mat shuru karo.

result.reply: Socho, Voltage (V) toh paani ki pressure hai jo pump (battery) daalta hai. Current (I) wo paani ka flow rate hai jo pipe mein nikalta hai. Resistance (R) toh pipe ki choti-badi hoti hai – agar pipe bahut patli hai, toh paani aana mushkil ho jata hai, waise hi agar resistance zyada hai, toh current kam padta hai. Formula R = V/I bas iska math hai: Pressure (V) flow rate (I) se divide karke pipe ki khatra (R) nikalte hain.
result.interpretation: User ne paani ke flow ki analogy maangi aur cloud kaam rokne ko bola, isliye main direct explanation de raha hoon.
proposed_actions: Agar aap chahein toh ek naya worked example solve karein jahan pressure aur pipe size do diya gaya ho.
